baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive أُذِنَ and يُقَٰتَلُونَ are causally tied to the passive ظُلِمُوا۟, then closed by نَصْرِهِمْ and قَدِيرٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A party already subjected to reciprocal lethal pressure receives a license because a grievance exists; permission opens a defensive act, the wrong supplies its jurisdictional cause, and support is figured as vindication backed by effective capacity.

activation_trace.role: The literal license or permission supplies the legal gate rather than an unconditioned command.
Mutual fighting supplies two-party pressure, while the focus passive places the licensed group on the receiving side.
Complaint and demand for equitable redress make the stated wrong an adjudicative trigger.
Withholding and confinement from a right specify the injury that the permission answers.
Vindication of the wronged gives support a redressive, not merely triumphal, function.
Effective capacity secures the possibility of redress without making human force self-authorizing.

changed_reading.before: A general command to initiate war followed by a promise of victory.
changed_reading.after: A causally gated defensive license for people already under attack and deprived of right, with divine support functioning as possible vindication.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ظُلِمُوا۟ ... نَصْرِهِمْ ... قَدِيرٌ can join wrong placement or deprivation to arrival, flow, and measured restoration.
baseline_models.mechanism: Wrong is modeled as putting persons or rights out of place and withholding them; support can then be an arrival or a channel that returns what was displaced, while capacity supplies a defined measure. Combat remains an instrument inside restoration rather than the endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in the wrong place supplies the displacement that calls for re-placement.
Withholding a right supplies the blocked possession or access to be restored.
Arrival at a land gives support a spatial role of return or restored presence.
Channels arriving from afar supply a flow model for reconnecting what exclusion cut off.
A measure that brings a thing to its limit bounds the restorative means and scale.

changed_reading.before: Support means defeating the opposing fighters.
changed_reading.after: Support may mean a measured return of displaced people, rights, and access to their proper places, with fighting subordinate to that repair.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أُذِنَ can activate not only license but notification, listening, and acceptance, while ظُلِمُوا۟ supplies a grievance to be heard.
baseline_models.mechanism: The permission is also a communicative event: a grievance is received, a boundary is announced, and a conflict becomes publicly intelligible as authorized defense rather than private vengeance.

activation_trace.role: Listening and accepting what is heard supply the receptive side of recognizing the wrong.
Knowledge and public notification make authorization an announced boundary.
The complaint branch supplies the claim that must be heard before the announcement has redressive force.
Two-sided combat is the contested situation that the communicative ruling classifies.

changed_reading.before: Permission is an invisible switch that simply releases force.
changed_reading.after: Permission is also the hearing and public classification of a grievance, distinguishing defensive action from unannounced retaliation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus grants permission in the perfect passive but predicates capacity over نَصْرِهِمْ rather than narrating an accomplished victory.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human defensive agency is opened now, while support remains under divine capability, planning, and timing. The clause therefore resists treating authorization as either a guarantee of immediate survival or proof that every later outcome ratifies the actors.

activation_trace.role: The granted license opens a human course of action in the present.
Aid and making the aided party prevail define the possible support without asserting that it has already occurred.
Capability marks sufficiency to act, not a disclosed timetable or automatic battlefield result.
Deliberative estimation keeps timing and form of support within ordered determination.

changed_reading.before: Once permission is granted, victory and survival are guaranteed on the actors' timetable.
changed_reading.after: Permission grants agency, while the form and timing of support remain distinct questions held within divine capability and determination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier obstruction of a common sacred route and space gives concrete content to the focus wrong: exclusion converts equal access into withheld right. The defensive license can therefore answer an access regime that precedes open fighting, not only an isolated bodily blow.

activation_trace.role: The focus combat remains the immediate anchor and prevents the access cue from becoming an independent theme.
Turning people away supplies the active obstruction that matures into the focus conflict.
Sanctity as protected right makes the barred access a breach of an owed immunity.
Equality between resident and visitor supplies the distributive norm violated by exclusion.
Withholding from a right links the earlier access injury directly to the focus cause ظُلِمُوا۟.

structural_cues: 22:25 precedes the focus with obstruction from the Sacred Mosque, explicitly equalized for resident and visitor, and calls the deviation ظلم.
The focus still names recipients as those being fought, so blocked access is antecedent injury rather than a free-standing warrant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obstruction, protected space, equality, and repeated ظلم; I infer that these form one antecedent chain culminating in the focus fighting. A live narrower alternative limits the focus cause to direct attack and treats 22:25 only as thematic background.

changed_reading.before: The wrong is unspecified private mistreatment that matters only once combat starts.
changed_reading.after: The wrong includes systematic denial of shared sacred access, with combat emerging from an already coercive architecture of exclusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root first performs a public summons and later names ears, while hearing supplies understanding and compliance. These recurrences activate the focus permission as an audible, intelligible ruling that receives a grievance and publicly marks the boundary of legitimate defense.

activation_trace.role: The focus license remains the legal anchor for the communicative activation.
Public notification by a call supplies the outward announcement side of authorization.
The bodily ear supplies the receiving interface that makes the root's communicative circuit visible.
Attentive acceptance turns mere reception into recognition of what has been announced.
Understanding and compliance make hearing function as uptake of the ruling, not sound alone.

structural_cues: 22:27 uses the root as a public call that gathers people; 22:46 pairs ears with hearing and understanding around the focus.
The focus passive leaves the authorizing speaker implicit, increasing the force of the public-speech activation without identifying a human issuer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root across call, permission, ear, and hearing; I infer a communicative chain from grievance reception to public classification. The live alternative is simple polysemy with no procedural implication.

changed_reading.before: Authorization is a private metaphysical release of force.
changed_reading.after: Authorization is also an announced and hearable judgment that makes the defensive status of the action publicly intelligible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, flesh and blood are denied access to God while protective piety is what reaches; divine دفع then wards harm from people in security or faith. The sequence revises the licensed fighting into a subordinate protective instrument and blocks its conversion into sacred blood-production.

activation_trace.role: Mutual combat anchors the revision in the focus rather than in sacrificial imagery alone.
Reaching a destination supplies the explicit contrast between rejected blood and accepted protective piety.
Known blood supplies the material explicitly denied divine receipt, constraining sacralized violence.
The split root's flowing-blood image reinforces the same excluded material without collapsing its alternate mapped inventory.
Warding off harm gives taqwa a protective mechanics that carries into the focus permission.
Removing a harmful thing frames defense as repulsion rather than acquisition or expansion.
Security and settled trust supply the protected condition toward which repulsion is directed.

structural_cues: 22:37, 22:38, and 22:39 form an immediate sequence from rejected flesh and blood, to protective دفع, to permission for those being fought.
The focus cause remains that the recipients were wronged, not that blood itself has ritual value.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a negated blood-to-God relation, protective taqwa, divine repulsion, and then licensed fighting; I infer that the sequence subordinates force to protection and denies sacrificial glorification. An alternative treats 22:37 as closing an unrelated ritual unit and gives the adjacency less control.

changed_reading.before: Licensed bloodshed can itself become a sacred offering or proof of devotion.
changed_reading.after: The license is an anti-sacrificial protective measure: blood has no devotional destination, while warding harm and restoring security govern force.

context_deltas.mechanism: Expulsion from homes identifies the focus wrong spatially; reciprocal دفع among human groups prevents structural collapse; the threatened objects are several kinds of worship place, not one faction's asset. Support thus protects a plural ecology in which divine naming remains materially possible.

activation_trace.role: Wrong placement anchors expulsion and threatened demolition back in the focus cause.
Forced passage outside supplies the concrete displacement suffered by the focus recipients.
Affiliation with and residence in a home makes expulsion a severing of situated belonging.
Pushing a harmful force aside supplies the balancing mechanism that prevents demolition.
Distinct portions of humanity supply multiple groups whose counter-pressure limits any one group's domination.
The collapse of buildings states the material failure that defensive counter-pressure prevents.
The branch naming Christian worship buildings makes the protected set explicitly non-singular in communal form.
Places of prayer and worship supply one mapped inventory for the protected institutional ecology.
The alternate mapped root also names worship places, preserving the split inventory's convergent contribution.
A designated place of prostration adds another concrete worship site protected from collapse.
Reciprocal aid joins divine support to human participation in maintaining the protective balance.

structural_cues: 22:40 grammatically continues the description of those licensed in 22:39 and specifies expulsion from homes for saying that God is their Lord.
The counterfactual demolition list spans hermitages, churches, prayer places, and mosques before returning to reciprocal support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expulsion, human counter-pressure, threatened buildings, multiple worship-site terms, and reciprocal support; I infer that preserving plural worship infrastructure is a purpose of the focus license. A live alternative reads the list only as a general image of devastation, not the license's normative scope.

changed_reading.before: Defense seeks the licensed group's victory and repossession alone.
changed_reading.after: Defense restores the expelled while preserving a plural public ecology of worship against monopolizing demolition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse tests the recipients after they obtain capacity: power must establish durable worship, circulate growth through alms, recognize public good, and restrain wrong. The focus permission is therefore audited by the social order it produces, while the final outcome is not possessed by the empowered group.

activation_trace.role: Capacity in the focus anchors the later question of how conferred capacity is exercised.
Empowerment supplies the condition under which the licensed group's conduct becomes observable.
Care, preservation, and responsible charge make establishment an ongoing custodial task.
Growth and increase give alms a distributive repair function after empowerment.
Recognizable good supplies a public norm toward which the restored order is directed.
Restraint from action supplies an internal brake on the conduct of the newly empowered.
The final outcome relocates ultimate closure beyond the group's possession of force or land.

structural_cues: 22:41 continues with the same relative group and makes its conduct under terrestrial empowerment the next test.
Prayer, alms, recognized good, restraint of wrong, and the outcome of affairs follow the combat permission without another military predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies empowerment followed by cultic, distributive, and normative acts; I infer these are outcome criteria for the focus license, not unrelated virtues. The alternative is that 22:41 merely describes the group without conditioning how 22:39 is read.

changed_reading.before: Success is achieved when the wronged acquire enough power to defeat or replace their opponents.
changed_reading.after: Success is tested after empowerment by worship, redistribution, recognizable good, and restraint, with ultimate outcome still belonging to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later migrants may be killed or die and still receive apportioned provision. This separates divine support from guaranteed battlefield survival: the focus promise of capacity can sustain the wronged across displacement and death rather than certify every immediate material outcome.

activation_trace.role: Aid in the focus is the claim whose temporal and material range the later sequence revises.
Movement from one home to another continues the focus recipients' displacement beyond the immediate conflict.
Actual loss of life prevents support from being reduced to invulnerability in combat.
Loss of life by death broadens the adverse outcome beyond being killed while preserving the following care.
Apportioned gift supplies a mode of support that remains operative after migration and death.

structural_cues: 22:58 explicitly coordinates being killed or dying after migration with a subsequent promise of provision.
The focus predicates capability for support, not immunity from the lethal branch of ق ت ل.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies migration, actual death, and ensuing provision; I infer that نصر in the focus cannot be equated with guaranteed survival. The live alternative keeps provision and support as separate promises without allowing one to revise the other.

changed_reading.before: Divine capacity for support guarantees that licensed defenders will survive and win materially.
changed_reading.after: Support can accompany agency without preventing death, extending as care and apportioned good beyond the immediate battlefield outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later response is explicitly matched to what was suffered, followed by renewed transgression against the responder and a promise of vindication; pardon and protective covering remain live beside it. This calibrates the focus license as equivalent counterforce with an off-ramp, not an expandable blank check.

activation_trace.role: The focus license is the legal opening that the later proportional structure bounds.
Consequence after an offense supplies a responsive, backward-linked action rather than initiation.
Equivalence and likeness impose a proportional ceiling on the response.
Crossing the limit through aggression identifies renewed excess as the condition for promised vindication.
Vindication of the wronged repeats the focus support after proportionate response and renewed aggression.
Leaving punishment and effacing the offense preserve a non-retaliatory off-ramp.
Protective covering supplies a second repair mode alongside equivalent counterforce.

structural_cues: 22:60 orders suffered action, equivalent response, renewed aggression, divine support, and then pardon and covering.
The sequence distinguishes response from excess by repeating the passive experience of being acted upon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equivalence, renewed transgression, support, pardon, and covering; I infer a ceiling and an off-ramp for the focus permission. A live alternative takes the divine names only as consolation and not as guidance for the response's shape.

changed_reading.before: Once wrong is established, the licensed side may escalate until it secures total victory.
changed_reading.after: The license authorizes bounded counterforce tied to equivalent injury and renewed aggression, while pardon remains a live route out of retaliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, the sky is continuously held back from falling and may fall only by permission, inside a frame of tenderness and mercy. The repeated permission root activates the focus license as a controlled exception within a larger regime of restraint, not as force's default release.

activation_trace.role: The focus license is the opening whose regulatory shape is revised by the later recurrence.
Continuous holding and confinement supply the surrounding default of restraint.
Falling and becoming fixed supply the potentially catastrophic motion that restraint controls.
Permission appears as the sole exception to ongoing holding, defining a narrow release condition.
Tender compassion orients the holding-and-permission system toward protection of people.
Merciful tenderness reinforces protection, rather than destructive release, as the governing end.

structural_cues: 22:65 places بِإِذْنِهِۦ after ongoing restraint of a catastrophic fall and before divine tenderness and mercy toward people.
The focus likewise opens with passive permission before naming the already pressured recipients and their wrong.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies holding, possible falling, permission, tenderness, and mercy; I infer a regulatory analogy in which restraint is default and release exceptional. The live alternative restricts 22:65 to cosmic governance and denies transfer to the conflict license.

changed_reading.before: Permission means that restraint has ended and force may now unfold on its own logic.
changed_reading.after: Permission is a narrow opening inside continuing restraint, justified by protection and still governed toward mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence denies any helper to wrongdoers, exposes invoked powers as unable to rescue, and then condemns failure to measure God before naming gathered strength and post-humiliation might. The focus capability clause is thus both a power contrast and a moral discrimination: capacity does not validate whoever possesses force.

activation_trace.role: Effective capability in the focus anchors the later correction of how power is measured.
The wrongdoer's withholding posture marks the side from whom support is explicitly absent.
The negated helper makes support morally unavailable to the wrongdoer rather than mechanically attached to power.
Failure to extract something from another's grip supplies the concrete rescue incapacity of false powers.
The opposite of strength marks both sides of the false rescue relation as incapable.
Measure and proper limit make the failure a mis-estimation, not only denial of abstract omnipotence.
Capability repeats the focus branch and corrects the powerless comparison.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope supplies integrated capacity rather than isolated violence.
Might after humiliation answers the focus recipients' wrong without making humiliation of others the goal.

structural_cues: 22:71 denies a helper specifically to wrongdoers; 22:73 stages failed rescue and weakness; 22:74 repeats ق د ر before strength and might.
The focus assigns support to those wronged, preserving the same moral polarity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated support for wrongdoers, failed rescue, weakness, proper measure, strength, and might; I infer that the focus capability is discriminating rather than a theology of sheer force. The alternative treats these as separate polemics against worship objects with no feedback into 22:39.

changed_reading.before: The final capability clause supplies overwhelming power that validates the stronger side.
changed_reading.after: The clause corrects false measures of power while withholding support from wrongdoers; capacity serves redress and cannot be equated with domination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing charge expands exertion to the full effort of worship, witness, prayer, alms, and protective attachment, while denying constriction and ending with helper language. The focus combat permission remains real but cannot totalize the community's striving or become a permanent condition of religion.

activation_trace.role: Mutual combat anchors the narrower activity that the closing frame places within wider exertion.
Expenditure of full effort under hardship broadens striving beyond one form of combat.
Negated constriction prevents the licensed conflict from becoming an all-enclosing religious pressure.
The branch image of inescapable fighting is activated under explicit negation, exposing permanent combat as a contained possibility rather than the norm.
Holding that prevents and protects supplies attachment, rather than aggression, as the community's final posture.
The closing helper repeats focus support after the broader duties, relocating reliance beyond combat.

structural_cues: 22:78 coordinates striving with selection, lack of religious constriction, witness, prayer, alms, protective attachment, patronage, and help.
Combat vocabulary is absent from the closing command even though support vocabulary returns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies broad exertion, explicit non-constriction, protective attachment, and repeated help; I infer that these prevent 22:39 from defining all striving as combat. The live alternative allows جهاد here to include warfare more centrally while still retaining the noncombat sequence.

changed_reading.before: The permission to fight becomes the defining and continuing form of religious striving.
changed_reading.after: Combat is one exceptional response within broader exertion ordered toward worship, witness, provision, restraint, and protective reliance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the drink-dilution branch of ق ت ل is form-distant from يُقَٰتَلُونَ; it remains anchored through the same focus root, measured capacity, and 22:60's equivalence and pardon. Render only as a material analogy for reducing violence's intensity, never as the surface lexical meaning of the combat form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The combat root's branch of breaking a drink's severity can interact with focus measure and the later proportional response.

activation_trace.role: Breaking a drink's harsh strength with water supplies the attenuation analogy for defensive counterforce.
Defined measure prevents attenuation from becoming an unlimited counter-intensity.
Equivalence supplies the calibrated amount of counterforce in the analogy.
Leaving punishment supplies the possible endpoint where intensity is reduced to non-retaliation.

changed_reading.before: Defensive force answers violent intensity by reproducing or exceeding it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, licensed counterforce acts like a reducing agent: enough to break aggression's severity, proportioned toward an eventual stop.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because rain and water-channel branches are remote from ordinary military support; it remains anchored in نَصْرِهِمْ, the measured قَدِيرٌ clause, and the packet's actual rain-to-green sequence. Render as an ecological model of restorative aid, not as a claim that نصر literally means rain here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The support root contains rain and converging water-channel branches, while the focus wrong can be withholding and capacity can be measured.

activation_trace.role: Withholding from a right supplies the dryness or blocked-flow side of the ecological model.
Rain and relief supply restorative aid that revives rather than conquers.
Channels arriving from afar supply distribution of aid into a shared basin.
Measured amount supplies calibration of restorative flow.
Delivering something downward supplies the arrival of restorative aid.
Conveying water by pouring or irrigation supplies the repair medium.
Flourishing and ease of life supply the social result of restored flow.
Gentle beneficence keeps restoration from being modeled only through overwhelming force.

changed_reading.before: Support is a decisive strike that destroys the opposing structure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, support is measured restorative flow that reconnects withheld goods and lets a damaged communal ground become livable again.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the 'fighter of winters' branch names one who defeats cold by feeding and warming people, far from the immediate combat form. It remains anchored in the focus ق ت ل and ن ص ر roots and is activated by post-migration provision in 22:58. Render only as a branch analogy that widens what defensive success sustains, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The combat inventory includes defeating winters through provision, and the support inventory includes gift, while later displaced people receive apportioned provision.

activation_trace.role: Defeating winter by feeding and warming people supplies a nonlethal model of what a defender overcomes.
Support as gift makes provisioning part of restored communal capacity.
Movement between homes supplies the displaced population whose survival requires more than battlefield action.
Apportioned gift activates concrete sustenance as a mode of support after displacement.

changed_reading.before: The defenders' relevant work ends with repelling armed opponents.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, defense also defeats exposure, hunger, and displacement by sustaining the community that violence endangered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it tests the temporal threshold of يُقَٰتَلُونَ through a later near-action construction. It remains anchored in the focus reciprocal-combat form and the packet's branch for approaching an act, but it should be rendered only as a question about visibly imminent assault, never as a general legal rule or a license based on suspicion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive reciprocal combat form can be tested against a later context in which hostile action is described as nearing execution.

activation_trace.role: Mutual fighting supplies the focus threshold whose temporal edge is being explored.
Approaching an act supplies visible imminence without claiming that the act is already complete.

changed_reading.before: Permission becomes relevant only after completed lethal injury.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, being under an overtly imminent assault may belong to the passive state of being fought, though mere apprehension does not.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from a generic war command to an adjudicated defensive license caused by attack, withheld right, and a heard grievance.
The 22:37-40 sequence made the license anti-sacrificial and protective, then widened its object from one group's victory to homes and a plural ecology of worship.
22:41 and 22:60 audited force by what empowerment builds, imposed proportional response, and kept restraint and pardon live.
22:58 and 22:65 separated support from guaranteed survival and recast permission as a narrow opening inside continued protective restraint.
22:71-78 bounded capability morally and placed combat inside a wider field of exertion, witness, provision, worship, and protective reliance.
summary.what_was_special: The same focus roots opened several coexisting domains: permission became call, hearing, and controlled exception; wrong became complaint, deprivation, and displacement; support became vindication, restored presence, provision, rain, and converging channels; capacity became both effective power and measured limit. The packet's immediate anti-blood and plural-site sequence supplied the strongest surprise, while the dilution, hydraulic, winter-provisioning, and imminent-assault readings remained contained but live.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether يُقَٰتَلُونَ denotes only combat already underway or can include an overtly imminent attack remains grammatically and normatively open.
The extent to which 22:40's several worship sites define the purpose of the license, rather than illustrating consequences of unchecked conflict, remains live.
The relation between divine دفع in 22:38 and human licensed action in 22:39 may be delegation, coordination, or two distinct modes of protection.
Arrival, rain, water-channel, dilution, and winter-provisioning branches are productive mechanism analogies but should not be promoted to surface lexical senses without further evidence.
Capability for support does not disclose its timing, form, or worldly outcome, especially given the later possibility of migration, killing, and death.
